_comment: Fleet config -- the single source of truth for HOW the orchestrator (optimizer/orchestrate/00_run_fleet.py) reaches each hardware target AND for the (app x backend x hardware) differential-coverage gate matrix (formerly the separate fleet-coverage.json, now removed). The gate matrix is DERIVED: per device, `coverage_backends` if present else all `backends`, mapped short->long via vocab.json, crossed with vocab.json app_stages -- see scripts/check_fleet_coverage.py. Per friendly hardware name this file gives: the --device id passed to the binaries, the deploy transport (ssh host / adb serial+host), the local build/ dir holding its binaries, which GPU backends it runs (`backends`), an optional `coverage_backends` subset that MUST run as differential-test cells (defaults to all `backends`; jetson uses [cu] because Vulkan correctness is gated on minipc/pixel/samsung, so jetson Vulkan is benchmarked but not a required coverage cell), optional per-app schedule-candidate caps, and an optional per-device `runs` override (profiling-run count; bump it on targets whose interference timings are noisy, e.g. minipc big cores on tiny kernels -> CV occasionally exceeds the loader's max_cv and drops the btpm table). Replaces the transport details previously scattered across 03_run_schedule.py + scripts/run-on-*.sh + the justfile (and fixes the justfile's stale jetson host: it is yanwen@duck-stable, reachable directly from this box, NOT duck-naughty).
